author: {Microsoft}

author: Li, Yichen and Pang, Qi and Xiao, Dongwei and Liu, Zhibo and Wang, Shuai

title: MPCDiff: Testing and Repairing MPC-Hardened Deep Learning Models
author: Pang, Qi and Yuan, Yuanyuan and Wang, Shuai

author: {National Design Studio}
support: Directly deploys a quantized browser PII model plus deterministic recognizers and leak evaluation.

title: Web Neural Network API
author: {W3C Web Machine Learning Working Group}

title: Using the WebNN Execution Provider
author: {ONNX Runtime contributors}
support: Documents WebNN setup and fallback of unsupported operators to WASM.
scope_limit: Flagged/experimental runs must be separate from shipped default availability.

title: Post-training quantization
author: {Google AI Edge}
